careerGoal.targetJobDescription:
Financial Consultant / Analyst – Fresher (Deloitte)

Role Overview
Entry-level position supporting Deloitte's Finance, Advisory, or Engagement Financial Management teams. You'll assist client-facing and internal engagement teams with financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, and compliance support, while building foundational consulting and finance skills.

Key Responsibilities

Support engagement/project financial management — budgeting, forecasting, billing, and receivables tracking
Prepare financial reports, dashboards, and MIS using Excel/PowerPoint (and tools like SAP, Power BI where applicable)
Assist with account reconciliations, expense coding, and transaction review
Conduct basic financial analysis (income statements, balance sheets, cash flow trends, KPIs)
Support client engagement teams with data gathering, documentation, and presentation prep
Ensure compliance with internal policies and quality standards
Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams on ad hoc finance projects

Eligibility / Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Business Administration (B.Com/BBA/BA-Economics etc.); MBA/M.Com sometimes preferred for select roles
Freshers or up to ~1 year of experience
Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
Good analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
Basic understanding of financial/accounting concepts

What Deloitte Typically Offers

Structured onboarding and training programs
Exposure to global clients and cross-border teams
Mentorship and defined career progression paths
Competitive compensation and benefits

A couple of notes:

Deloitte India (USI) often hires freshers under titles like Analyst – FP&A, Engagement Financial Advisor, or Associate Analyst – Finance, rather than literally "Financial Consultant" — worth checking the exact title on the live posting.
Actual JDs differ by business unit (Consulting, Advisory, Global Finance Support, etc.) and location
